title: Dust hides the middle of our galaxy
description:
Mid-infrared light pierces the dust and reaches NASA’s SPHEREx satellite. This is close to why sunsets are red.
Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech SPHEREx; data from NASA/IPAC IRSA. Processing: The Bright Nobles (Muhammet Mücahit Soylu, Serdar Aydın, Furkan Küpeli), ChronosphereX.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
APOD page: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-25-spherex-seeing-through-dust/
